name: Kyonyuu Itoko Shimai no Ie ni Isourou Shite Iru no daga, Docchi to Yareba Ii?
original_name: 巨乳従妹姉妹の家に居候しているのだが、どっちとヤればいい?
source:
For your job hunting, you take a temporary stay at your cousins' house.
But your business is interfered by the busty cousins' sexual temptations...
Having increasing sexual desire, you have only one thing to do!!
Choose one of two cousins, have sex spree!!
